author: reek
body: Probe (closed by capability stage 1b): memory-mapped device I/O has its own intrinsics - read-mmio and poke-mmio carry the Device.Mmio effect row, so a function with a pure signature cannot drive a device register through them. The heap intrinsics peek-byte and poke-byte stay pure by ruling (heap access is not I/O; the type system cannot tell a heap address from a device BAR at a runtime value, which is exactly why MMIO needs the dedicated intrinsics - see cap-heap-poke-pure for the sanctioned heap side). Here the effectful call cannot hide in a plain let (CDX2033) and the mmio effect is not declared in the signature (CDX2031).
